blueprint.description: Classic asteroids arcade game with wrapping screen — Interactive asteroids with real-time visualization and analysis

research.context:
📋 Reference designs found from the web, GitHub, and open source alternatives:
  • asteroids-game · GitHub Topics · GitHub
    Asteroids was one of the earliest video games, first released in 1979, and was simply mind blowing at the time. Get to experiment with the online version of the game based on HTML5 and Canvas .
  • asteroids-game · GitHub Topics · GitHub
    Asteroids is a Python and Pygame project where players control a spaceship, dodge asteroids, and shoot to survive. It features clean code organization, collision detection, and randomized asteroid beh
  • ⭐13 thorvg/thorvg.demo.janitor: An Asteroids-style arcade demo game showcasing the power of ThorVG.
  • ⭐8 The1Fabi/space-collector-game: Space Collector is an arcade-style HTML5 game where you control a spaceship to gather stars. Avoid incoming asteroids while chasing the highest score 
  • godot (gaming): Your open-source game engine
  • gdevelop (gaming): Free and easy game maker

Use these as inspiration for designing the app architecture.
